lines.1: 「My sweet scent has already filled the whole room.」
lines.3: 「Nwooooh! It finally showed up! The first one this year!」
lines.4: 「Leave it to me. I'll shoot it dead with my air gun.」
lines.7: 「What...? She took the shot to protect the roach...」
lines.8: 「I've never heard of a heroine shielding a cockroach before...」
lines.9: 「Maybe she felt a kinship between two creatures the world has no need for...」
lines.10: 「If you shoot it with an air gun, bits of it will spray all over my bed, moron! I'll pass around a note in class telling everyone to ignore Fukahire!」
